reviewer: Independent fresh Hermes subagent; not implementer
scope: Read-only source/security/functional review; synthetic offline execution only

findings.title: Unknown attachments and malformed historical content parts are forwarded rather than rejected
findings.description: The projection validates only exact image_url parts. Every other item is appended without a content-part schema check. PrivacyPolicy.sanitize is a generic tree/denylist filter, not a message-schema validator: file_url, unrecognized_attachment, text with a numeric value, and null all pass. A real agent.run_agent synthetic conversation containing text + recognized image_url + file_url reaches the intercepted Chat Completions provider with file_url intact even when K90_ALLOW_MODEL_IMAGES=false. The image is omitted, but its accompanying arbitrary attachment is now allowed out. Under the previous image-disabled history path the same mixed record was blocked by the historical image. This violates the required fail-closed malformed/ambiguous/arbitrary-attachment contract and the documentation claim.
findings.recommendation: Validate the complete historical multipart schema before discarding any image: allow only explicitly supported text parts with string text and recognized validated image_url parts; reject unknown types, non-object parts and malformed fields. Keep original full-tree secret/local-only checks first and preserve all existing restrictions. Add actual-agent regression proving an unknown attachment accompanying an image never reaches any provider.

verified.independent_adversarial_tests: 5 failed in 3.63s; exit 1; four missing fail-closed exceptions plus one actual provider-boundary violation; review-original-probes.log
verified.host_identity: No blocking finding: new stable UUIDv4 URN; narrow canonical bare UUIDv4 migration only for host_id-only registration without credentials filesystem entry; bindings/credential presence and symlinks protected; shared authorize initializer and relevant tests exercised.
verified.photo_happy_paths: Existing tests exercise actual agent across Chat Completions, Responses and subscription, local and synthetic Hindsight adapter, both follow-up flags, unchanged local originals, preserved assistant interpretation, no meal auto-write, denied new upload without consent.
verified.hindsight_boundary: Worker outbound_document and HindsightBackend retain/recall each apply a baseline image-denying PrivacyPolicy independently of model consent.
